OpsBot: INCIDENT [sev2] svc-inference-prod p99 latency spike — pager routed to #eng-oncall at 2024-11-03T09:31:30Z
Jin Park: i'm primary for this window, picking up the pager. seeing spike in p99 from 190ms -> 2.1s on the dashboard
Priya Rao: on it. rough impact? any customer-facing 5xxs?
Jin Park: no 5xx, mostly slow responses and queued requests. top affected routes: /v1/generate (hosted), embeddings bulk. region NA-east.
Tomas L: looked at k8s: pod cpu/gpu ok, but inference queue length is high. suspect KV cache thrash + batching backlog.
Asha S: +1 on kv cache. saw increased cache eviction on the memstats alert earlier.
Priya Rao: can you pull the trace? linking quick trace: https://console.redwood/instrumentation/trace/abc123 (internal)
Jin Park: trace shows lots of cold-starts for model-variant gpt-small-quant, and retries to fallback model that have higher latency.
OpsBot: Auto-action suggested: scale up pool inference-prod-warm by +2 nodes (estimate +18% qps) — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference/scale-warm-pool
Tomas L: quick mitigation plan: 1) scale warm pool (fast) 2) temporarily increase batch window to reduce perf tail? 3) pin traffic away from fallback variant
Asha S: batch window increase usually helps throughput but could increase p95 for small requests. maybe reduce max_concurrency on the fallback route first.
Priya Rao: i'm going to scale warm pool. command: 
```
# aws / infra tool
infractl scale --pool inference-prod-warm --add 2 --zone na-east-1
```
Priya Rao: kicked the scale, infractl job id 4582. watching.
Jin Park: i'm going to update the routing policy to deprioritize fallback-quant for hosted tier while we stabilize. small config snippet: 
```
route.modify("/v1/generate").set_fallback_weight("fallback-quant", 0.1)
```
Tomas L: FYI if scale doesn't reduce queue, next step is to enable prefix KV caching on heavy merchants. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/caching/prefix-kv-cache
Asha S: customer impact note for post-incident: affected requests slowed, no errors. approx 12% of hosted requests in na-east saw >1s latency between 09:28-09:44 UTC. likely user-facing timeouts for some interactive apps.
Jin Park: adding TAG: customer-impact: degradation_interactive. we should open a postmortem ticket after mitigation.
Priya Rao: infractl reports warm pool nodes coming up, two nodes healthy at 09:34:10Z. queue length down ~30% already.
OpsBot: Alert suppressed: p99 latency returned below threshold for 10m — auto-close condition met? (you can still keep thread open)
Jin Park: leaving thread open for handoff. Primary remains me until 10:30UTC. secondary is Tomas.
Tomas L: I'll remain secondary until 11:00 UTC. if latency creeps back, escalate to oncall-sre.
Asha S: flagged an owner for follow-ups: create ticket and add runbook links + metrics snapshot. template: https://redwood.internal/ops-templates/postmortem-template.md
Priya Rao: leaving a quick remediation checklist for next primary/secondary: 
- Check warm pool capacity: infractl status --pool inference-prod-warm
- Inspect KV cache evictions: kvcache-monitor --service svc-inference-prod --last 30m
- Route weight sanity: route.describe "/v1/generate"
- If p99 > 1s after scale, trigger rollback of last model rollout: modelctl rollback --model gpt-small-quant --to stable-2024-10-30
- Open customer-impact ticket and paste these screenshots
Jin Park: noted. coverage gap: between 10:30-11:00 UTC the scheduled oncall rotation swap happens and no primary is assigned in calendar because @lee is OOO. Tomas — can you cover that full window or do we need to shadow?
Tomas L: i can cover 10:30-11:00 but would prefer a 10-minute overlap with the next rotation.
Asha S: I'll ping ops-scheduler to ensure overlap on shift swap. also dropping runbook shortcuts in thread for quick access: 
- Scale warm pool: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference/scale-warm-pool
- KV cache troubleshooting: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/caching/prefix-kv-cache
- Model rollback: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/modelops/rollback
- Postmortem template: https://redwood.internal/ops-templates/postmortem-template.md
Priya Rao: closing checklist once stable: 
1) Confirm p99 < 500ms for 15m
2) Close suppressed alert and annotate with mitigation steps
3) Create postmortem ticket, tag @sre, @product (customer-impact)
Jin Park: marking thread for handoff notes. next primary (after 10:30UTC) to confirm recovery and reopen if needed. thanks all :thumbsup:
Tomas L: noted. i'll take the 10:30-11:00 slot and monitor dashboards.
OpsBot: Incident auto-note: mitigation performed: scaled inference-prod-warm +2 at 09:34:10Z, route weight adjusted, KV cache investigation queued. incident duration so far: 13m
Asha S: quick FYI for handover — if you see repeated cold-starts, follow this extra step: pre-warm model variant with: 
```
modelctl prewarm --model gpt-small-quant --replicas 4 --zone na-east-1
```
Jin Park: last message before handoff: I will leave detailed bookmark in the ticket with graphs + this thread. switching to LHR soon, will remain reachable for 5 more mins.
Priya Rao: thanks. good ops.
Jin Park: handing to Tomas now — go ahead.
Tomas L: taking over. monitoring.
